Root cause: resolveCandidate() (src/data/componentCatalog.ts) checks the hand-authored CATALOG override table BEFORE entityClass-based resolution (EWO-STAB-004A precedence, preserved deliberately for cases like "Baler Salvage Head"). This display name has a single-size CATALOG entry that is correct for only some ships; other ships sharing the same display name at a different real size are misvalidated against the wrong size, even though their own factoryEntityClass would resolve correctly if the override did not take precedence.
